title: [2026-09-30] fix: retire Nova Canvas and Reel
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes Nova Canvas and Nova Reel, including their four aliases, from the registry and generation dispatch; no fallback is added.
- Removes obsolete handlers and pricing while preserving historical migration records and the AWS binding. No endpoint route or method is removed.
- Rejects all six retired IDs in model lookup and generation, and omits them from catalogs.
- Validation: 239 Gen, 539 Enter, 58 SDK, 433 shared-provider and 7 Floret tests passed; Gen/Enter/SDK typechecks, Biome and diff checks passed. After incorporating MiniMax pricing, 474 additional pricing/alias checks passed.
- The September 30 08:00 UTC gate has passed; maintainer authorized merge and production deployment. Refreshed against current main without conflicts; fresh full CI runs before merge. [AWS retirement notice](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-lifecycle-legacy.html).

gist.headline: Two models leave the shelf
gist.blurb: Nova Canvas and Nova Reel have left the model shelf, along with their four aliases. The catalog shows the models still available; old IDs get a clear rejection, not an unexpected substitute.
gist.summary: Retired Nova Canvas, Nova Reel, and their four aliases from the model registry and generation dispatch after the AWS retirement gate; catalogs omit all six IDs, and lookup and generation reject them without fallback.
gist.impact: Catalogs now show the available models; requests using any of the six retired IDs are rejected, so callers can select another listed model without changing API routes.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-library garden: Polli, wearing a tiny librarian hat, places two labeled model cards, Nova Canvas and Nova Reel, into an archive box while the remaining model cards stay on a lime-green shelf. The archive represents retirement rather than a replacement or fallback.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients over a prominent lime green (#ecf874) and warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
